title: New Tech Drives Renaissance in Offshore Drilling
summary: Technology improvements are driving a renaissance in offshore drilling in the United States. And it’s not a moment too soon, as many analysts believe shale is nearing its peak. Also, with the energy transition not going as fast as hoped, some new oil and gas supply would come in quite handy.
